name: StarLight
source:
You start the game by waking up inside a locker, having no memories of why or how you got there. You meet three slightly strange kids, Beep, Bunny, and Trig. Make decisions and see where they lead you...

Will you start dating one of them? Will you get killed? Will you commit murder?
The possibilities are not endless but theres a lot of them!

[From [url=https://zerosugar.itch.io/starlight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏开始时，你在储物柜里醒来，完全不记得自己为何、又是怎么来到这里的。你遇见了三个有些古怪的孩子：哔普、邦尼与特里格。做出选择，看看它们会将你带向何处……

你会与其中一人交往吗？会被杀死吗？还是会亲手杀人？
可能性虽非无穷无尽，但也相当丰富！

[摘自[url=https://zerosugar.itch.io/starlight]Itch.io[/url]]
